snippet.title: Silent Fangs: Stealthy Vampire's Tale - Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Silent Fangs: Stealthy Vampire's Tale Demo will be playable in Steam Next Fest between 13-20 October.
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668110/Silent_Fangs_Stealthy_Vampires_Tale/
Join Discord: https://discord.com/invite/7zTzmSmDx7

"Silent Fangs is a PS1-style hack ’n slash where a fallen vampire fights through brutal massacres and roams a gothic open world. Rebuild your lost kingdom, uncover its secrets, and meet bizarre allies who mix dark humor with cryptic guidance."

Also Check out Way of Madness Trailer: 
https://youtu.be/GkfRTyO4gis?si=due5hYjkkQZ2bjt1
